description:
Social tools for the Draftless AI creative studio. Requires sign-in to run. Actions:
- list_social_accounts: List the social accounts connected to Draftless — TikTok, Instagram Business, Facebook Pages, and Meta ad accounts — with the connection id 
- prepare_publish: Step 1 of publishing to TikTok.
- publish_post: Publish a video or image PUBLICLY to a connected TikTok, Instagram Business, or Facebook Page account.
- get_publish_status: Check whether a publish_post job has gone live.
- create_ad_draft: Turn a generated image or video into a Meta ad.
- get_ad_performance: Read what the user's Meta ads actually did over a recent window — spend, results, cost per result, click-through and video hook retention pe
- record_social_outcome: Record the observed performance of a short-form post (impressions, engagement rate, watch time, CTR).

input.description: Arguments for the action (see discover.describe_action once signed in).

name: social
title: Social
